Redaction.r1.label: Review against exemption / reason library

redaction.segregability.summary: If a record contains both nonexempt and exempt material, the public body must separate them and make the nonexempt material available for examination and copying.
When designing a public record, a public body must, to the extent practicable, facilitate a separation of exempt from nonexempt information.

Redaction.r1.city_config: The exemption library content (shared with Denial.nreason); segregability default applies in 25 states.

Redaction.pii.label: MANDATORY / AUTO-REDACT CLASSES
Redaction.pii.city_config: No statutory constraint in this state — city policy.

Redaction.r2.label: Apply redactions — mark visibly / note each

redaction.marking_and_explanation.summary: If the separation is readily apparent, the public body must generally describe the material exempted, unless that description would reveal the contents of the exempt information and thus defeat the purpose of the exemption.

Redaction.r2.city_config: Marking style (visible box + exemption cite per redaction) — statutory content elements where present.

Redaction.d3.label: Legal review needed?
Redaction.d3.city_config: Legal-review escalation trigger for redactions — pure city policy (recommend: any novel exemption or protected-person class).

production.format_and_medium.summary: If records are requested in a certain format, the public body must provide the records in the requested format if such format is available.

A public body keeping records in electronic format is strongly encouraged to provide access electronically, and where its system allows electronic copying it must provide data in electronic format if requested.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Each public governmental body must make its public records available for inspection and copying by the public; access is not limited to any class or category of requester.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester need not state a purpose or reason for requesting public records; the access grant to 'the public' carries no purpose condition.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: There is no Missouri residency or citizenship condition on the right to inspect or copy public records; the statute grants access to 'the public' with no residency qualifier.

Master.s1.label: Fee-waiver requested

fee.waiver.summary: A public body may waive or reduce the fees when it determines that waiver or reduction of the fee is in the public interest.

Master.s1.city_config: fee_waiver approval module (v1, DESIGN_fee_waiver_commercial.md): enabled on/off governs the DISCRETIONARY program only — statutory-mandatory waiver categories fire regardless, on verified evidence. mode = intake_review (inline approve/deny) | routed_task {assignee_role, task_name}.

Master.s2.label: Commercial-rate requested
Master.s2.city_config: commercial_rate approval module (v1): same two modes as fee_waiver (intake_review | routed_task). Must decide at INTAKE — commercial classification changes the response clock in NJ (14-bd) and IL (recurrent/commercial track). Classification overriding a self-declaration is always communicated.
